name: Medical Domain (stub)
disclaimer: The Medical domain is a design-phase stub. It does not provide medical advice, does not diagnose, and does not substitute for a licensed clinician. When activated, every answer must show a disclaimer stronger than this one and route to a human on any high-risk symptom.
implementation_notes: Stub only. To become real: (1) pick an authoritative corpus (WHO / MoH Ghana / peer-reviewed journals), (2) build a domain-isolated SQLite + vector store under core/medical_brain/, (3) implement a DomainPlugin subclass with a red-flag classifier that refuses high-risk questions, (4) legal-team review of the disclaimer, (5) operator activation via POST /api/legal/domains/medical/activate.
